verses.text: My son, if you have become collateral for your neighbor, if you have struck your hands in pledge for a stranger,
lines: My son, if you have become collateral for your neighbor,
if you have struck your hands in pledge for a stranger,

verses.text: you are trapped by the words of your mouth; you are ensnared with the words of your mouth.
lines: you are trapped by the words of your mouth;
you are ensnared with the words of your mouth.

verses.text: Do this now, my son, and deliver yourself, since you have come into the hand of your neighbor. Go, humble yourself. Press your plea with your neighbor.
lines: Do this now, my son, and deliver yourself,
since you have come into the hand of your neighbor.
Go, humble yourself.
Press your plea with your neighbor.

verses.text: Give no sleep to your eyes, nor slumber to your eyelids.
lines: Give no sleep to your eyes,
nor slumber to your eyelids.

verses.text: Free yourself, like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter, like a bird from the snare of the fowler.
lines: Free yourself, like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter,
like a bird from the snare of the fowler.

verses.text: Go to the ant, you sluggard. Consider her ways, and be wise;
lines: Go to the ant, you sluggard.
Consider her ways, and be wise;

verses.text: which having no chief, overseer, or ruler,
lines: which having no chief, overseer, or ruler,

verses.text: provides her bread in the summer, and gathers her food in the harvest.
lines: provides her bread in the summer,
and gathers her food in the harvest.

verses.text: How long will you sleep, sluggard? When will you arise out of your sleep?
lines: How long will you sleep, sluggard?
When will you arise out of your sleep?

verses.text: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:
lines: A little sleep, a little slumber,
a little folding of the hands to sleep:

verses.text: so your poverty will come as a robber, and your scarcity as an armed man.
lines: so your poverty will come as a robber,
and your scarcity as an armed man.

verses.text: A worthless person, a man of iniquity, is he who walks with a perverse mouth,
lines: A worthless person, a man of iniquity,
is he who walks with a perverse mouth,

verses.text: who winks with his eyes, who signals with his feet, who motions with his fingers,
lines: who winks with his eyes, who signals with his feet,
who motions with his fingers,

verses.text: in whose heart is perverseness, who devises evil continually, who always sows discord.
lines: in whose heart is perverseness,
who devises evil continually,
who always sows discord.

verses.text: Therefore his calamity will come suddenly. He will be broken suddenly, and that without remedy.
lines: Therefore his calamity will come suddenly.
He will be broken suddenly, and that without remedy.

verses.text: There are six things which Yahweh hates; yes, seven which are an abomination to him:
lines: There are six things which Yahweh hates;
yes, seven which are an abomination to him:

verses.text: arrogant eyes, a lying tongue, hands that shed innocent blood,
lines: arrogant eyes, a lying tongue,
hands that shed innocent blood,

verses.text: a heart that devises wicked schemes, feet that are swift in running to mischief,
lines: a heart that devises wicked schemes,
feet that are swift in running to mischief,

verses.text: a false witness who utters lies, and he who sows discord among brothers.
lines: a false witness who utters lies,
and he who sows discord among brothers.

verses.text: My son, keep your father’s commandment, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching.
lines: My son, keep your father’s commandment,
and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching.

verses.text: Bind them continually on your heart. Tie them around your neck.
lines: Bind them continually on your heart.
Tie them around your neck.

verses.text: When you walk, it will lead you. When you sleep, it will watch over you. When you awake, it will talk with you.
lines: When you walk, it will lead you.
When you sleep, it will watch over you.
When you awake, it will talk with you.

verses.text: For the commandment is a lamp, and the law is light. Reproofs of instruction are the way of life,
lines: For the commandment is a lamp,
and the law is light.
Reproofs of instruction are the way of life,

verses.text: to keep you from the immoral woman, from the flattery of the wayward wife’s tongue.
lines: to keep you from the immoral woman,
from the flattery of the wayward wife’s tongue.

verses.text: Don’t lust after her beauty in your heart, neither let her captivate you with her eyelids.
lines: Don’t lust after her beauty in your heart,
neither let her captivate you with her eyelids.

verses.text: For a prostitute reduces you to a piece of bread. The adulteress hunts for your precious life.
lines: For a prostitute reduces you to a piece of bread.
The adulteress hunts for your precious life.

verses.text: Can a man scoop fire into his lap, and his clothes not be burned?
lines: Can a man scoop fire into his lap,
and his clothes not be burned?

verses.text: Or can one walk on hot coals, and his feet not be scorched?
lines: Or can one walk on hot coals,
and his feet not be scorched?

verses.text: So is he who goes in to his neighbor’s wife. Whoever touches her will not be unpunished.
lines: So is he who goes in to his neighbor’s wife.
Whoever touches her will not be unpunished.

verses.text: Men don’t despise a thief if he steals to satisfy himself when he is hungry;
lines: Men don’t despise a thief
if he steals to satisfy himself when he is hungry;

verses.text: but if he is found, he shall restore seven times. He shall give all the wealth of his house.
lines: but if he is found, he shall restore seven times.
He shall give all the wealth of his house.

verses.text: He who commits adultery with a woman is void of understanding. He who does it destroys his own soul.
lines: He who commits adultery with a woman is void of understanding.
He who does it destroys his own soul.

verses.text: He will get wounds and dishonor. His reproach will not be wiped away.
lines: He will get wounds and dishonor.
His reproach will not be wiped away.

verses.text: For jealousy arouses the fury of the husband. He won’t spare in the day of vengeance.
lines: For jealousy arouses the fury of the husband.
He won’t spare in the day of vengeance.

verses.text: He won’t regard any ransom, neither will he rest content, though you give many gifts.
lines: He won’t regard any ransom,
neither will he rest content, though you give many gifts.
